split_note: Each government’s share is one slice unless it publishes a debt split.
rollback_note: Virginia requires a lowered (equalized) rate to be advertised when reassessment raises the tax base. Arlington’s equalized rate wasn’t found in an official notice, so it isn’t shown.
hearing: The County Board sets the rate each April.
limits: The stormwater utility fee ($268 per equivalent residential unit in 2026) is billed with the real estate tax but isn’t a property tax and isn’t included.
